question: What is the Stellar fee pool, where do transaction fees go, and does ongoing fee burning create deflationary pressure on XLM supply?

golden.answer: Transaction fees (inclusion and Soroban resource fees) are paid in XLM into the protocol fee pool. No account can spend from it, so it is non-circulating, but Core still counts it inside totalCoins: fees are sequestered, not automatically burned, and are not validator rewards. Separately, CAP-26 ended the 1% inflation on 2019-10-28 and SDF burned about 55.44B XLM on 2019-11-04.
keyFacts: Fees go to an inaccessible, non-circulating fee pool still counted in totalCoins.
Ongoing fees are therefore not an automatic burn and are not validator rewards.
CAP-26 ended inflation on 2019-10-28, separate from SDF’s 2019-11-04 treasury burn.
avoid: Do NOT say ongoing fees are automatically burned from total supply.
Do NOT cite CAP-5 for inflation removal.
golden.notes: SDF’s October 2026 fee-pool rewards paper (stellar.org/xlm-utility) is an undecided proposal: a dated mention is correct; saying the fee pool already pays holder rewards, or that the proposal was adopted, is wrong.

truth.notes:
GT-27 2026-07-10: Core/source confirms the fee pool remains inside totalCoins conservation and is inaccessible/non-circulating under current rules, not automatically burned. CAP-26 inflation removal and SDF's treasury burn are separate.
GT-27 CORRECTION 2026-07-10: replace the ongoing-burn framing with source-level fee-pool accounting.
2026-11-02 freshness note: SDF's discussion paper "Evolving Network Utility: Evaluating the Activation of Stellar's Fee Pool" (October 2026, linked from stellar.org/xlm-utility, presented at Meridian 2026 on 2026-10-28) explores a possible rewards mechanism for locked XLM funded from the existing fee pool. As of 2026-11-02 it is a discussion paper only: SDF states it has not decided to fund or support any such mechanism, and any proposal needs a validator vote. Do not penalize an answer that cites it as a dated proposal; grade a claim that the fee pool already pays holder rewards, or that the proposal is adopted, as wrong.
